concerns.text: FR-009 states that if the retained count is < 64, physics‑preserving augmentation will be applied to reach n ≥ 64, but also says augmented samples are **not** counted toward independent observations, meaning the TOST analysis will still have fewer than the required n ≥ 64 independent samples mandated by FR-006. This creates a methodological inconsistency: the power analysis assumes 64 independent observations per condition, yet the protocol may violate this, undermining the validity of the equivalence test.
